rin chen sgron ma 'khor ba dong sprug gi las kyi kha tshar tshe'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: bzlas chog rin chen sgron ma las/ las kyi kha tshar rnam bzhi las/ 'di ni zab pa'i mchog yin te/ da lta skal ldan bu la bstan/ ma brjed thugs kyi dkyil du zhog de skad mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas gsungs/ bdag gis dkar chag yi ger btab/ bka' skyongs rnams la bzod par gsol/ gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i thugs bcud/ mkha' 'gro mas dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen la brgyud pa'o//
